say:1:1621781001:1.text: Who was humming just now? That sounded really good...
say:1:1621781001:1.source_cn: 刚刚是谁在哼歌呀，还挺好听的。

say:2:1621781002:1.text: Not me, and definitely not Leo. When Leo sings, he sounds like a quacking duck.
say:2:1621781002:1.source_cn: 不是我，肯定也不是利奥。利奥唱歌像是鸭子叫。

say:5:1621781004:1.text: Um, that was me, just humming because I felt good... I hope you don't mind my poor singing.
say:5:1621781004:1.source_cn: 那个，其实是我随便哼的，因为心情很好……我唱歌不太好听...

say:6:1621781005:0.text: No, that was great! Sing a little more, please!
say:6:1621781005:0.source_cn: 没有啊，很好听的！再唱一段，唱一段！

narration:7:1621781006:1.text: You relish the feast amid laughter and chatter. The scary episode has finally come to an end.
narration:7:1621781006:1.male: You relish the feast amid laughter and chatter. The scary episode has finally come to an end.
narration:7:1621781006:1.female: You relish the feast amid laughter and chatter. The scary episode has finally come to an end.

narration:8:1621781007:1.text: As you wave goodbye to everyone after the meal, a thought suddenly crosses your mind...

narration:8:1621781007:1.female: As you wave goodbye to everyone after the meal, a thought suddenly crosses your mind...
